info.name: Trimble Mobile Manager Catalyst Positioning API

params.name: format
params.description: Position data format version. locationV2 includes extended fields for IMU orientation, TIP positions, and reference frame data.

items.docs: Initiates position streaming from the connected GNSS receiver. Returns the WebSocket port number for connecting to the position stream. After calling this endpoint, open a WebSocket connection to ws://localhost:{port} to receive real-time GNSS position data.
